source.interpretation: Official 2D cableway axes; source Stand dates retained per installation. No cable sag, altitude profile, observed cabins or live operational status.
source.transformation: Approximate swisstopo LV95-to-WGS84 polynomial, seven decimals, no geometry simplification.

supportingEvidence.disposition: Supporting evidence only, not timetable replacement or geometry. Published summer interval endpoints differ from the pinned GTFS exclusive frequency endpoints; see docs/GRAUBUENDEN-CABLEWAYS.md.

expansionEvidence.purpose: Official operator context; no timetable substitution or geometry tracing. Samnaun L1 refurbishment/L2 summer operation blocks the exact-number candidate despite its small endpoint gaps.

scope: Every annual canton-calling mountain route. Identity leads are exact station-number overlaps only; they do not approve installations, operators, aliases, routes or journeys. Inactive routes use annual in-canton calls, not an invented dated full journey.
